card.name: Verbs before out, off, or back
card.fires_on: Motion or change-of-state verbs such as drops, blasted, dropped, made, passed, falling that come right before a particle like out, off, back, or a transition word. Seen in general web text.

modes.label: Drop out / drop the ball
modes.description: Forms of drop right before out of school or the ball.
modes.example: someone who<< drops>> out of school.

modes.label: Blast off
modes.description: Rocket launch verb blasted before off.
modes.example: Conrad jumped and cheered as the rocket<< blasted>> off a few miles away.

modes.label: Other passing or transition verbs
modes.description: Verbs like made, passed, make, falling, pass that start a phrasal verb or transition.
modes.example: large numbers of recipients of TANF<< make>> the transition to work.

card.writes: It seems to favor Chinese words for exiting, advancing or rising, but the effect is weak and unclear.
card.plain: It lights up on verbs like drops or blasted that are about to be followed by out, off, or back.
